text: Zainab runs Zuri Atelier. She adds apprentice Dami on the Team page.
Tap Add staff, then type Dami’s name and her mobile number.
What she does: a shift manager, who also hands the shift over.
She taps Send the invitation. Taskiem messages Dami on WhatsApp.
Dami waits under Waiting to join until she says yes.
Once Dami joins, she is on the Team page, in today.
